verdict.rationale: Fern ships AI features, including Fern Agent and Ask Fern, so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair axis for this product. However, all MCP evidence describes Fern acting as an MCP server for docs sites and for the organization. Nothing shows Fern acting as an MCP client that connects to third-party MCP servers and uses their tools. That server-side evidence does not transfer to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
